copy: Canvas tab: grid size + snap-to-grid. SEO tab: default site title. Full settings live in S7.

targets.name: RETIRED — Project settings modal (⌃,) · superseded by the full-page Settings per V2 section 6 · Navigation Structure (2797:404-406: Settings surfaces = 2, a 3-tab modal and a 13-screen full page with no link between them) — NOT per UX-I-30, which V2's own QA lane refuted. Canvas (grid size + snap-to-grid) folds in as a Settings › Canvas section and ⌃, + the Site menu's 'Site settings' row point there, so site configuration has one home. Kept as the record of what shipped 2026-09; it is not a second surface to design against.
